text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak meets soon with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in Cairo and warns against the eruption of violence due to a new housing porject in Jerusalem. Mubarak said after inaugurating of an oil field "I called on Netanyahu to avert any decision on Jerusalem."
- Egypt and Tunisia to discuss the creation of a joint free trade zone. The issue will be discussed by the Egyptian-Tunisian joint committee, chaired by the prime ministers of the two countries.
- Mubarak inspects the development of the latest oil discovery near the northwestern city of Matruh. The field produces 3,500 barrel of oil and 1,500 tonnes of gas per day.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri carries a message from Mubark to Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali. Ganzouri will co-chair the joint committee meeting in Tunis this evening.
- Mubarak orders the creation of an independent authority to operate the New Valley project.
- President of Niger Ibrahim Bare Mainassara hails the experiment of building new cities in Egypt.
